expiration_handling.purpose: Allow dashboard charts and historical review after contracts expire.

ingestion_requirements: Append a new option_quotes row for every observed contract on each chain fetch.
Do not delete quote history when a contract expires.
Update option_contracts.status to expired when expiration_date has passed.
Keep Greeks nullable because not every data source provides every Greek on every fetch.

privacy_requirements: Do not store passwords, tokens, credentials, or secrets.
Avoid storing raw IP addresses; store a hash or coarse location only if needed.
Keep event metadata focused on dashboard behavior, not personal content.
dashboard_interactions.purpose: Understand dashboard usage patterns, user behavior, feature adoption, and navigation flows over time.

ingestion_requirements: On first run for a ticker, fetch from default_start_date through the requested end date.
On later runs, read backfill_log.last_date and fetch only last_date + 1 day through the requested end date.
If the app has been stopped for multiple days, fetch only the missing date range.
Do not re-pull full history unless --force-full is explicitly requested.
Update backfill_log after successful inserts so future runs know the latest stored date.

requirements: Compute performance from the first stored trading day on or after added_date.
Primary workflow should accept only a ticker and look up saved index-addition records automatically.
Filter the index selector to only supported index lists where the entered ticker is currently present.
Keep dashboard watchlist add/remove actions synced into database tables.
Do not store index-addition event data in config files.
Support ad hoc analysis by ticker, index_key, added_date, and optional benchmark_ticker as a fallback.
Support saved index-addition records from index_additions.
Report total return, annualized return, days held, 6M/1Y/2Y forward returns, since-addition return, periodic monthly/quarterly/yearly returns, and optional benchmark/excess return.
Add ingestion/source discovery for real index-addition dates before relying on ticker-only lookup.
